name: Astral Archer grants ranged critical strike rating equal to 10% of Intellect (#1321)
contract: Astral Archer 681330 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, Rank 'Specialization', passive, CharacterAdvancement 12142,
Moonbow tab, RequiredLevel 20) reads 'Increases your ranged critical strike rating by $s1% of your Intellect. In
addition, gaining mana no longer generates threat.' Its only effect is effect 0: SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT
(220), EffectBasePoints 9 with DieSides 1 = 10, EffectMiscValue 512 = bit 9 = CR_CRIT_RANGED, EffectMiscValueB 3 =
STAT_INTELLECT. The report's premise (the id is absent from the source, so nothing applies it) does not hold for
this clause: Player::UpdateRating adds int32(CalculatePct(GetStat(miscValueB), amount)) to every rating in the
mask and Player::UpdateStats re-runs it whenever Intellect changes; no contract or script touches 681330. The
threat clause has no DBC effect; starcaller-astral-archer-mana-threat covers it. Both fixtures are the
same race, class and level with no gear, so archer minus control is the talent's contribution: 10% of the
archer's Intellect, truncated (at most one point below, so 0.085..0.1001 for Intellect of 67 or more). Arcane
Intellect 42995 (+60 Intellect in effect 0) is then applied to both: the archer's ranged crit rating follows
the Intellect gain at 10% (6 of 60, 0.083..0.117 with truncation on both readings) while the control, which
gains the same Intellect, gains no ranged crit rating at all, so the rating comes from the passive.
